CancorOptions.tol#summary.en: Numerical tolerance used to determine the ranks of x and y. Default 1e-7.

CancorOptions.xNames#summary.en: Names for the columns of x.

CancorOptions.xcenter#summary.en: Center the columns of x by their means, leave them uncentered, or supply explicit centers. Default true.

CancorOptions.yNames#summary.en: Names for the columns of y.

CancorOptions.ycenter#summary.en: Center the columns of y by their means, leave them uncentered, or supply explicit centers. Default true.

CancorResult.cor#summary.en: Canonical correlations, ordered from largest to smallest.

CancorResult.xcenter#summary.en: Centers applied to the columns of x.

CancorResult.xcoef#summary.en: Canonical coefficients for x, with original variable names in rows.

CancorResult.ycenter#summary.en: Centers applied to the columns of y.

CancorResult.ycoef#summary.en: Canonical coefficients for y, with original variable names in rows.

LdaCVResult.class#summary.en: Leave-one-out predicted class label for each training observation.

LdaCVResult.posterior#summary.en: Leave-one-out posterior class probabilities, with classes in columns.

LdaFit.N#summary.en: Number of observations used to fit the model.

LdaFit.counts#summary.en: Number of training observations in each class.

LdaFit.lev#summary.en: Class labels in prediction and prior order.

LdaFit.means#summary.en: Class means, with classes in rows and predictors in columns.

LdaFit.prior#summary.en: Prior class probabilities in the order of `lev`.

LdaFit.scaling#summary.en: Metric-normalised discriminant directions, with predictors in rows and dimensions in columns.

LdaFit.svd#summary.en: Singular values associated with the discriminant dimensions.

LdaFit.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while fitting the model.

LdaOptions.CV#summary.en: Return leave-one-out cross-validation predictions instead of a fitted model. Default false.

LdaOptions.groupLevels#summary.en: Declared class levels; unused levels remain in `lev` and produce warnings.

LdaOptions.levels#summary.en: Explicit factor levels for formula variables.

LdaOptions.method#summary.en: Fitting method; only "moment" is supported. Default "moment".

LdaOptions.prior#summary.en: Prior class probabilities, in class-level order. Defaults to observed class proportions.

LdaOptions.tol#summary.en: Numerical tolerance for rank determination and within-class covariance calculations. Default 1e-4.

LdaOptions.xNames#summary.en: Names for predictor columns in matrix input.

LdaPrediction#summary.en: Plug-in prediction from an LDA fit.

LdaPrediction.class#summary.en: Predicted class label for each observation.

LdaPrediction.posterior#summary.en: Posterior class probabilities, with classes in columns.

LdaPredictionOptions.dimen#summary.en: Number of discriminant score dimensions to return. Defaults to all available dimensions.

LdaPredictionOptions.method#summary.en: Prediction method; only "plug-in" is supported. Default "plug-in".

LdaPredictionOptions.newdata#summary.en: New predictor rows; omitted to predict the observations used to fit the model.

LdaPredictionOptions.prior#summary.en: Prior class probabilities for this prediction. Defaults to the fitted priors.

LdaTable.cols#summary.en: Column labels, or null when columns are not named.

LdaTable.rows#summary.en: Row labels, or null when rows are observations without labels.

LdaTable.values#summary.en: Numeric matrix entries in row-major order.

ManovaFit.coefficients#summary.en: Regression coefficient matrix, with terms in rows and responses in columns.

ManovaFit.formula#summary.en: Formula used to fit the model.

ManovaFit.residualSSP#summary.en: Residual sum-of-squares-and-cross-products matrix on the original response scales.

ManovaFit.responseNames#summary.en: Names or expressions of the response variables in formula order.

ManovaFit.responseScales#summary.en: Power-of-two scale factors used internally for each response.

ManovaFit.termDf#summary.en: Degrees of freedom contributed by each sequential term.

ManovaFit.termNames#summary.en: Sequential model terms in formula order.

ManovaFit.termRoots#summary.en: Generalized roots for each fitted term, keyed by term name.

ManovaFit.termSSP#summary.en: Sum-of-squares-and-cross-products matrix for each fitted term, keyed by term name.

ManovaFit.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while fitting the model.

ManovaOptions.tol#summary.en: Numerical tolerance used to determine matrix and residual ranks. Default 1e-7.

ManovaSummary#summary.en: Four multivariate test tables and associated matrices.

ManovaSummary.Eigenvalues#summary.en: Generalized roots for each displayed model term.

ManovaSummary.SS#summary.en: Sum-of-squares-and-cross-products matrices, keyed by model term and residuals.

ManovaSummary.coef#summary.en: Regression coefficient matrix with labelled rows and response columns.

ManovaSummary.royFIsUpperBound#summary.en: Roy largest-root F approximation is an upper bound.

ManovaSummaryOptions.intercept#summary.en: Include the sequential intercept row when the fitted model has one. Default false.

ManovaSummaryOptions.tol#summary.en: Numerical tolerance used when recomputing the generalized roots. Default 1e-7.

ManovaTestName#summary.en: Name of a multivariate test statistic.

MatrixTable.cols#summary.en: Column labels, or null for a matrix without named columns.

MatrixTable.rows#summary.en: Row labels; a scalar string is used for a one-row table.

MatrixTable.values#summary.en: Numeric table entries in row-major order.

cancor#@param options.en: Column centering, rank tolerance, and optional column names.

cancor#summary.en: Canonical correlation analysis. Equivalent to R's `stats::cancor()`. Coefficients use the unscaled cross-products, with deterministic paired signs.

lda(0)#@param options.en: Prior probabilities, tolerance, and leave-one-out CV.

lda(0)#summary.en:
Linear discriminant analysis (moment method). Equivalent to R's `MASS::lda()`. The moment method only. Supports matrix/group and formula/data-frame inputs.
Directions are metric-normalised and their signs are deterministic.

lda(2)#@param options.en: Prior probabilities, tolerance, and leave-one-out CV.

lda(2)#summary.en: Linear discriminant analysis from a formula, e.g. `"class ~ x1 + x2"` or `"class ~ ."`.

lda(3)#@param options.en: Prior probabilities, tolerance, and leave-one-out CV.

lda(3)#summary.en:
Linear discriminant analysis (moment method). Equivalent to R's `MASS::lda()`. The moment method only. Supports matrix/group and formula/data-frame inputs.
Directions are metric-normalised and their signs are deterministic.

ldaPredict#@param options.en: New observations, prior override, and number of discriminant scores.

ldaPredict#summary.en: Plug-in prediction for a fitted {@link lda} model. Equivalent to R's `predict.lda()`. The plug-in method only.

manova#@param formula.en: Multivariate formula, e.g. `"cbind(y1, y2, y3) ~ group + covariate"`.

manova#summary.en:
Fit a multivariate analysis of variance model with sequential (Type I) terms. Equivalent to R's `stats::manova()`.
The response is `cbind(y1, y2, ...)`; all four classical MANOVA statistics are available in {@link manovaSummary}.

manovaSummary#@param options.en: Select a statistic or request the intercept row.

manovaSummary#summary.en: Summary tables for all four MANOVA statistics, with optional sequential intercept row. Equivalent to R's `summary.manova()`.
